title: Autocomplete
description: An input with suggestions that accepts free-form text; the value is the text itself.

components.Autocomplete: Groups all parts of the autocomplete, which lets the user type freely and pick from suggestions.
components.AutocompleteAnchor: Frames the input and its buttons as one field, and marks where the suggestion list attaches.
components.AutocompleteCancel: Clears the text the user has typed.
components.AutocompleteEmpty: Shows a message when no suggestion matches the text.
components.AutocompleteGroup: Groups related suggestions under an optional heading.
components.AutocompleteInput: Takes the text the user types; the suggestions filter as it changes.
components.AutocompleteItem: Holds one suggestion; picking it fills the input with its text.
components.AutocompleteList: Holds the suggestions while the autocomplete is open.
components.AutocompleteSeparator: Separates groups of suggestions in the list.
components.AutocompleteTrigger: Opens and closes the suggestion list.
components.AutocompleteViewport: Scrolls the suggestions when the list is longer than the space available.
